Technical experience or insight in a manufacturing or production environment Willingness to work shifts (3-shift system) Own transportation (the site has limited public transport access) Fluency in Dutch, English, or German A curious, precise, and growth-oriented mindset Wat bieden wij je? €20.18 gross per hour (including allowances - see below for the breakdown) Full-time, 37.5 hours a week in 3-shift rotation Travel reimbursement Full onboarding and personal coaching to get you up to speed Chance to move to a permanent contract once you've proven yourself Room to develop yourself through training and growth opportunities A friendly, professional team with people from all over the world How does the salary work?
